name: Popups
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Popups.
Write the offer, choose imagery, and select the signup form or link destination before enabling the popup. A newsletter form collects an opt-in; it does not create or send a discount code.
Choose a trigger and frequency, then preview desktop and mobile. Use the editor preview option to inspect it when stored frequency rules would hide it.
Check Escape, the close button, focus return, and readability. Keep the underlying page usable when the popup is dismissed.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Enable global popup
settings.how: Turn on “Enable global popup” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Preview popup in theme editor
settings.info: Opens once per preview render without storing frequency. Works while the storefront popup is disabled. Close it normally to continue editing.
settings.how: Turn on “Preview popup in theme editor” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it. Saved frequency state can prevent the popup from appearing again in the same browser. Use the editor preview control to review content without treating it as a new customer subscription.

settings.label: Popup trigger
settings.info: Exit intent works on desktop pointer exit only. First visit uses browser storage only when Shopify permits preference storage; otherwise it lasts for this page. Manual uses a configured popup opener.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup trigger. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Delay before showing
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust delay before showing. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Scroll trigger percent
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust scroll trigger percent. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Popup frequency
settings.info: Automatic display occurs at most once per page. Session/day/week memory requires Shopify preference permission and usable browser storage; otherwise page memory only. Manual open bypasses frequency. This is not tracking consent.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup frequency. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance. Saved frequency state can prevent the popup from appearing again in the same browser. Use the editor preview control to review content without treating it as a new customer subscription.

settings.label: Show on mobile
settings.how: Turn on “Show on mobile” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show on desktop
settings.how: Turn on “Show on desktop” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Close when overlay is clicked
settings.how: Turn on “Close when overlay is clicked” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Popup placement
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup placement. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Popup animation
settings.info: Reduced-motion preferences disable movement. None opens and closes without transitions.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup animation. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Popup eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the popup eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Popup heading
settings.how: Enter the popup heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Popup text
settings.default: Get updates, offers, and helpful store news delivered occasionally.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Popup image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Primary button label
settings.how: Enter the primary button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Primary button URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Secondary button label
settings.how: Enter the secondary button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Secondary button URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Show newsletter form
settings.info: Native Shopify newsletter signup with explicit email marketing confirmation. Does not install an email app or change Shopify tracking consent.
settings.how: Turn on “Show newsletter form” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Newsletter placeholder
settings.how: Enter the newsletter placeholder. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Newsletter button label
settings.how: Enter the newsletter button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Popup style
settings.info: Minimal hides the image; Commerce adjusts heading measure. Width, padding and colors below apply to every style.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Popup image position
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for popup image position. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Popup background
settings.how: Choose a color for popup background. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Overlay opacity
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust overlay opacity. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Popup radius
settings.info: Fullscreen uses square screen edges; other placements use this radius.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust popup radius. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Popup width
settings.info: Maximum dialog width; constrained by the screen. Fullscreen fills the screen. Side images stack on smaller screens.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust popup width. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Popup padding
settings.info: Content padding. Extra space at the top keeps the close button clear of the heading.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust popup padding. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.
